title: Speaker names only where speeches start
statement: In a play's text on screen, show a speaker's name only where a speech starts, as a printed script does, not on every line.
example: A test checks that of a scene's first four lines only the first and the fourth carry a speaker's name.
detail: Another build's renderer drew this engine's play text in its own script layout, and its first render showed a speaker's name on every line. It was fixed so that a name appears only where a speech starts, and a test on the exported lesson checks the speakers of the first four lines: a name, none, none, a name.

evidence.quote: (speaker names only where a speech starts, fixed after the first render showed them on every line)
a name only where a speech starts
